question: Should OpenClaw accept Podman agent sandboxing as an official bundled plugin in this repository, or should the implementation live externally unless maintainers identify a missing core/plugin API?
rationale: The feature is plausible through the existing sandbox backend seam, but accepting it changes official sandbox posture, plugin packaging, configuration, docs, and security-review ownership.

options.title: Review as bundled backend
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the official Podman backend candidate and require security, dependency, docs, and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish a ClawHub/npm plugin using existing SDK seams, then revisit official bundling after adoption or a proven API gap.

options.title: Defer to broader backend planning
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the broader execution-backend direction before accepting another bundled container backend.

recommendation.title: Review as bundled backend
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the official Podman backend candidate and require security, dependency, docs, and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this account to the OpenShell sandbox plugin pattern, sandbox backend documentation, and product-facing plugin boundary decisions.
